description: This is a Java source file defining an abstract Android activity class 'CobaltActivity' that extends GameActivity. It manages activity lifecycle, surface view handling, intent processing, and JNI native method calls, specifically for the Cobalt project with custom deep link and argument handling.

classes.name: CobaltActivity
classes.description: An abstract Android activity class for Cobalt, managing lifecycle, surface views, deep links, and JNI interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets volume stream, manages deep link, creates video surface view.

methods.name: onCreateSurfaceView
methods.description: Creates an empty view to prevent default SurfaceView creation.

methods.name: createStarboardBridge
methods.description: Abstract method to instantiate the StarboardBridge.

methods.name: getStarboardBridge
methods.description: Returns the current StarboardBridge instance.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Handles activity start, dumps device info, manages surface view recreation.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Handles activity stop, sets surface view to fullscreen.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Handles activity destruction.

methods.name: onSearchRequested
methods.description: Delegates search request to StarboardBridge.

methods.name: getArgs
methods.description: Collects command-line style arguments from intent extras and metadata.

methods.name: appendUrlParamsToUrl
methods.description: Appends URL parameters to the --url argument.

methods.name: addCustomProxyArgs
methods.description: Adds proxy configuration arguments if system proxy is detected.

methods.name: detectSystemProxyConfig
methods.description: Detects system proxy host and port.

methods.name: isReleaseBuild
methods.description: Checks if the build is a release build.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intents, passing deep links to StarboardBridge.

methods.name: getIntentUrlAsString
methods.description: Extracts URL string from intent data.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Delegates permission results to StarboardBridge.

methods.name: resetVideoSurface
methods.description: Resets the video surface view.

methods.name: setVideoSurfaceBounds
methods.description: Sets position and size of the video surface view.

methods.name: createNewSurfaceView
methods.description: Recreates the video surface view.

methods.name: onLowMemory
methods.description: Handles low memory warning, calls native low memory event.

methods.name: getAppStartTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the app start timestamp.

methods.name: setPreferMinimalPostProcessing
methods.description: Sets minimal post-processing preference if supported.
